content: The river that forgets its ancestral source will dry up in the desert sand.
author: African Proverbs
sourceWork: Odo ti o ba gbagbe orisun re, yoo gbe — Yoruba Proverb
explanation: A mighty river rushes through plains with thunderous force only because high in the mist of the distant mountains, pure springs continue to feed its current. When an individual or culture severs connection with its ancestral roots and moral heritage, it dries into arid dust.
practicalInsight: Reflect on the moral sacrifices of your parents or grandparents today. Draw fresh water from their enduring example.
reflectionPrompt: What foundational values or heritage have you drifted away from that need to be reconnected?
